map.输入系统额定/实测压力、泄漏量、振动频率、油温，基于规则推理诊断液压系统可能故障: Enter the system's rated and measured pressure, leakage, vibration frequency and oil temperature to diagnose possible hydraulic faults by rule-based reasoning and give repair advice
map.压降率 = (额定压力 Pr − 实测压力 Pa) ÷ Pr × 100%；判定: Pressure drop rate = (rated pressure Pr - measured pressure Pa) / Pr x 100%; thresholds: above 5% flags insufficient pressure (above 30% severe, above 15% moderate, the rest mild); internal leakage above 500 mL/min is severe and above 200 is on the high side; oil temperature above 85C is overheating and above 70 is high; vibration above 200 Hz suggests cavitation, above 50 suggests pump pulsation, and the rest points to mechanical looseness.
map.按规则推理诊断液压系统故障。以压降率为主线索：压降超过 5% 判定系统压力不足，: Diagnose hydraulic system faults by rule-based reasoning. Pressure drop rate is the main clue: a drop above 5% is judged insufficient system pressure, then internal leakage, oil temperature and vibration frequency localize the root cause - large leakage points to seal damage, medium leakage to valve wear, and small leakage is often a relief valve set too low; high oil temperature is usually inadequate cooling; vibration is split by frequency band into cavitation, pump pulsation and mechanical looseness. When factors stack up (pressure drop > 15% with oil temperature > 75C) it is judged an overall system efficiency decline needing a full overhaul.
map.压力上不去的因果定位（泵/溢流/内漏）。: Causal diagnosis of pressure that will not build up (pump / relief valve / internal leakage).
map.动作迟缓与噪声的关联分析。: Correlation analysis between delayed movement and noise.
map.按压力-流量曲线判元件退化。: Judge component degradation from the pressure-flow curve.
map.：设定 16 MPa 实测 10 MPa，先查溢流阀弹簧是否失效、再查泵内泄与缸: With 16 MPa set and 10 MPa measured, first check whether the relief valve spring has failed, then check pump internal leakage and cylinder external leakage, isolating step by step.
map.：保压 500 s 掉 2 MPa，多为单向阀或缸密封泄漏，非泵问题。: A hold of 500 s losing 2 MPa is usually a check valve or cylinder seal leak, not a pump problem.
map.管路（壁厚/流速/压降）设计: Piping (Wall Thickness / Velocity / Pressure Drop) Design
map.怎么快速定位？: How Do I Locate the Fault Quickly?
map.用切断法分段隔离：锁泵、锁阀、锁缸看压力恢复点，定位故障元件。: Use the cut-off method to isolate by section: lock the pump, lock the valve, lock the cylinder and watch where pressure recovers to localize the faulty component.
map.气蚀与吸入不足常伴噪声且压力不稳，优先查油位与吸油管。: Cavitation and insufficient suction usually come with noise and unstable pressure, so check the oil level and the suction line first.
